newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Lentex sets issue price at PLN 18-23.
newsitem.headline: Polish Lentex sets issue price at PLN 18-23.

text.p: Polish carpet maker Lentex SA set the issue price of its 1.5-million-share initial public offering at between 18 and 23 zlotys per share, the firm said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.

The firm, which seeks the main market's listing, will offer 900,000 shares in the large investor tranche from January 28-30 and 500,000 shares in the small investor tranche from January 28 to February 5.
It offers 100,000 shares for employess and the company's management from January 28 to February 5.
Lentex earned net 11.2 million zlotys on sales of 150.2 million zlotys in 1995.
It said it expected its net profit to rise to 12.1 million on 149.6-million-zloty sales in 1997.
